abilities.name: Levitate
abilities.effect: If this Pokémon has any Energy attached, it has no Retreat Cost.

attacks.name: Split Spiral Punch
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Knocking Hammer
attacks.effect: Discard the top card of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Shakedown
attacks.effect: Discard a random card from your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Berkshire
attacks.effect: If your Benched Pokémon have any damage counters on them, this attack does 90 more damage.

attacks.name: Live Painting
attacks.effect: Reveal any number of basic Energy cards from your hand. This attack does 30 more damage for each type of basic Energy you revealed in this way.

abilities.name: Sky Circus
abilities.effect: If you played Bird Keeper from your hand during this turn, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs

attacks.name: Wind Shard
attacks.effect: This attack does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Warm Up
attacks.effect: Search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Victory Dive
attacks.effect: You may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Wintry Call
attacks.effect: Search your deck for up to 2 Melony cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Icy Wind
attacks.effect: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Energize
attacks.effect: Attach a Lightning Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.
